# SolveLang

SolveLang is a readable, explainable workflow language designed for AI-assisted business processes.

SolveLang is an early-beta open-source language and tooling project. The Rust CLI is the canonical runtime for supported `.solve` workflows. Workflow Intelligence Studio provides local-first deterministic analysis. The browser preview uses a pinned WebAssembly safe-core build with host side effects denied, not the full hosted runtime.

SolveLang is not a production durable workflow engine or a general-purpose autonomous AI workforce platform.

## Working today

- Rust lexer, parser, AST runtime, interpreter, CLI, diagnostics, and hardened local execution modes
- Local-first deterministic Workflow Intelligence Studio analysis
- A pinned browser-safe core preview
- Deterministic n8n workflow preflight tools
- Public examples and documentation
- Rule-based workflow audit and support-triage planning previews; no remote tasks or messages are executed

## Deployed with gates — evidence dated September 17, 2026

- Public site hosted on AWS Amplify
- Production API access and customer-account infrastructure verified enabled
- Production API subscription billing and checkout verified enabled
- Stripe Developer / Pro / Business prices, subscription webhook signature enforcement, and billing-failure monitoring verified
- First real-payment canary still pending; broader public payment availability is not yet claimed
- Paid priority and provider activation remain separate rollout gates

Deployment evidence is not a live health feed or a general-availability claim. Current health is not independently verified by the public status page.

## Experimental or test-mode

- Provider-backed AI and side-effecting HTTP, file, and environment helpers
- Provider integrations requiring scoped credentials, qualification, and explicit authorization
- Draft generation that still requires canonical validation before execution

## Planned

- Connected inbox-to-action support automation
- General managed workflow execution and broader qualified production integrations
- Additional platform evidence
- Independent uptime monitoring and operational exercises

## Important boundaries

- Workflow Intelligence Studio analysis is deterministic rather than AI analysis.
- Public audit and triage previews are rule-based, not connected autonomous agents.
- A proposed workflow or draft is not authorization for an external action.
- No production uptime, SLA, adoption, revenue, or performance benchmark is claimed.
- Private account, checkout, credentials, payment, and uploaded-workflow information is not part of the public search surface.
